{{Quote|If necessary, I can invoke Directive One-Oh-Three. In the absence of orders to the contrary, all fleet officers&mdash;''"<br />"''I'm familiar with the directive. It doesn’t apply to us.|Calo Drusan to Voss Parck|<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Directive 103''', also known as '''Directive One-Oh-Three''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] directive that [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Calo Drusan]] attempted to invoke in order to force Captain [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] to follow his orders. However, Parck countered that the directive did not apply to him or his [[Task Force Admonitor|task force]].<ref name="Choices of One" />
